scenarios.name: ClosedXML extension join-text: TEXTJOIN traversal delimiter coercion and empty inputs — TEXTJOIN(",",TRUE,A1:B2)
evidence: https://github.com/ClosedXML/ClosedXML/blob/09f2f21a60e821ce7fb18ca3576b272e5dd6d921/ClosedXML.Tests/Excel/CalcEngine/TextTests.cs#L1101: TextJoin_joins_arguments_with_specified_delimiter
Expected behavior adapted from this upstream assertion. TEXTJOIN traversal delimiter coercion and empty inputs. Not derived from Poirot output.

Replace the empty B1 value with numeric zero and restore it. Zero contributes text 0 even when empty text is omitted; area row-major traversal and separate-argument order follow the source assertions.

LibreOffice 26.2.6.3 620(Build:3): every retained expected value was independently recalculated on 2026-10-17 through fresh OOXML snapshots and typed cached results. See ../evidence/closedxml-extension-libreoffice.json. This is a Calc reproduction, not a native Excel claim.
